title: Kaisay Kaha Hoga Ali Akbar Ko Alwida Beemar Nay
body:
Alwida, Alwida Kub Aaogay Poocha Hoga Ro Ro Kay Sogwaar Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba Kay Seenay Say Lipat Ker Rothi Hogee
Mujhay Chore Kay Muth Jao Mei Thanha Merjaoongi
Roungee, Jub Paray In Ujray Ujray Sehnon Mei, Ghurbath Kay Din Guzaar Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila Nay Jub Chooma Haey Sughra Kay Sar Ko
Hasrath Say Thaka Hoga Maan Nay Ali Akbar Ko
Ankhon Say, Aansouon Kay Mothi Dhaal Keeyai Hongay Beti Ko Maan Kay Pyaar Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Ko Reh Reh Kar Wo Goud Mei Laithee Hogee
Shayad Na Milain Phir Hum Tharap Ker Kehthi Hogee
Kya Kahay, Kis Tharha Rothay Houay Behn Ki Jholi Ko Chora Tha Sheer Khaar Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas Dam-e-Rukhsath Hathon Ko Malthay Hongay
Ger Kuch Na Kaha Hoga Aansou Behthay Hongay
Aaeyngay, Hum Tujhai Lainay Yeh Aeyd Keeya Hoga Bibi Say Allamdar Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain Kay Sadqay Mei Karam Haider Nay Kiya Hai
Moula Kay Gadager Ka Sharaf Zehra Say Leeya Hai
Do Jahaan, Kee Dua’eyn Lee Hain Saani-e-Zehra Say Akhthar Say Pursadaar Nay
